title: Research four held grasses; measured botanical keys, authentic hybrid release, real Canyon muhly source photos
summary: Updated four existing held canonical Poaceae species and their four genus lessons with explicit original-source research and exact diagnostic handoffs; holds NOT artificially closed.

reviews.key: Nonrhizomatous tuft; 25–40 mm usually two-bent awns; arching axis mainly one-sided vs rhizomatous S. nutans with generally shorter 2–15 mm once-bent awns.
reviews.needs: Documented same-plant rootstock and measured attached awn plus independent determination, and separate local native-range evidence.

reviews.key: USDA NRCS 2020 Welder Germplasm documented accession 9085260, PI 645601. Kew mature fertile lemma 2.2–2.9 mm with 2–5 mm awn; upper sterile lemma 1.7–2.2 mm with 1–2 mm awn.
reviews.needs: Matched photographic upper sterile + fertile flower dissection of individual candidate, and a specimen determination.

reviews.key: UT Austin Bob Harms exact-source living plant (MUIN-a), scaled flowering head (MUIN-I) and collar (MUIN-L) visually verified on public source pages. These are not in local gallery; historic illustration remains.
reviews.photo_rights: UT PRC freely permits noncommercial use, but publication of >5 images or any commercial use requires permission. No site-wide rights count established and no reproduction carried out.
reviews.needs: Choose separately licensed original CC photo or audit site-wide UT reuse count / obtain permission for source images; verify actual attached floret measurements before final scientific closeout.

reviews.key: Wipff & Shaw 2018: generally smooth sheaths, enclosing spathe <2.5 mm, ligule membrane <1 mm with long cilia, sessile spikelet <3.8 mm; separate Anatherum eremicum has scabrous sheaths, >2.5 mm spathes, 1–2 mm membrane and >4.2 mm spikelets.
reviews.needs: Source-validated same-plant photographs of actual enclosing raceme spathe, true ligule and mature attached sessile spikelet with ruler; historical pumilus synonym remains accepted under tenuispatheum.

publication_note: This is a research/diagnostic hold improvement, not a HOLD clearance or new validated source-image admission; Pages only claim after run success.
